Resolves #18547

Refs #17844

The two "reveal header matches inline tab chrome" arms were red on a stale golden, not on a regression. A railed pane still resolves its owning edge extent (`commits` 0.14 on the right), and `RevealOverlay#syncSnapshot` renders `max(revealExtent, defaultRevealFraction)`; the Workstation raised that floor to 0.35 in dfcbda2959 (#18038, fixing #18028), 75 minutes after ddde9ba701 (#18019) wrote the 359px goldens. The 886px overlay is that floor over a narrower committed band. The arm now reads the floor and the rendered ratio before its screenshots, and all four goldens are regenerated. No production change.

Evidence: L3 (real Chrome + Neural Link against the external Brain runtime on macOS; this NL tier does not run in CI) → L3 required (AC-2, AC-4). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: receipt refresh — four regenerated goldens, one assertion, one trimmed unit arm; no production file.

## Deltas from ticket
The Fix section's two remaining candidates — the Rail never asks, or the overlay ignores what it receives — are both wrong: the overlay receives 0.14 and applies the floor #18028 specified ("treat `defaultRevealFraction` as both fallback and minimum"). The disposition is the baseline branch, with its cause named. The first commit's investigation narrative in the unit arm is trimmed to the resolver contract.
